messages:
From: Sarah Park <sarah@phalanxai.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-06-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Dedicated capacity demo request — PhalanxAI (throughput & p99 latency)

Hi Karthik,

Thanks — we just completed the self-serve onboarding and the app is already routing a small amount of traffic to a trial model. We're interested in a Dedicated capacity walkthrough focused on throughput and latency guarantees so we can decide whether to commit to a reserved pool.

Quick context:
- Prod expected steady QPS: ~350 requests/sec, with 2–3x burst windows (up to ~800).
- Typical prompt length: 60–120 tokens; occasional long contexts up to ~1k tokens for retrieval-augmented flows.
- Latency targets: p50 < 20ms, p95 < 60ms, p99 < 120ms (we know p99 is ambitious).
- Peak concurrency: up to 600 simultaneous sessions during batch jobs.
- Data residency: US-East (we're in AWS us-east-1).

We attached a small sample of traffic traces (sample_traffic.csv) and a short note on the models we're evaluating. Goal for the session: a 30–45 minute technical walkthrough with a Solutions Engineer to cover sizing, autoscaling behavior, and caching (prefix/KV). Would also like to see how rollouts and fallback policies would look in a prod incident.

Availability: we are US Eastern time — afternoons generally work best for us next week. Please let me know 2–3 slots and any pre-demo checklist you need.

Thanks,
Sarah Park
Head of Platform Engineering
PhalanxAI

Attachment: sample_traffic.csv (text/csv, 12 KB)
